key_findings: Melatonin reversed reserpine-induced fibromyalgia-like pain, restoring SIRT1/PGC-1α and reducing p38 MAPK/NF-κB, cytokines and microglial activation.
Melatonin reduced glutamatergic markers (VGLUT, PSD-95, NMDA, AMPA) in spinal dorsal horn and PSD-95/synaptophysin in DRG.
